question: According to Census of India 1901, what was the total population of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 1901, the total population of India was **238.40 million**.
 
• This census was the first comprehensive population census conducted in India.
 
• The data collected during the 1901 census is considered a vital historical record for understanding the demographic changes in India over the years.
 
• The census was conducted under the British colonial administration and provided detailed information on various demographic parameters.
 
• It laid the foundation for subsequent censuses conducted in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world.
 
• The data collected during the census is used for planning and policy-making by the government.
 
• It includes information on population size, distribution, density, and various socio-economic indicators.
 
• The census helps in understanding the demographic trends and patterns in the country.
 
• The most recent census in India was conducted in 2011, and the next one is scheduled for 2021.
